chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Sufyan from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

A time will come upon the people when the one who asks the people will live and the one who remains silent will die. I said, 'So what should I do if I attain that time?' He said, 'Assist them with what is with you, and if you do not find (material means), then strive (for it).'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended conduct during times of hardship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes a period of hardship where asking for help ensures survival while silence leads to death. He advises the seeker to provide assistance from their own resources, and if material means are lacking, to exert effort and strive to acquire what is needed to help others.
